document.abstract: At a meeting of the New York Section of the Society, held at New York on December 13th, the following address was delivered by MY. Barton through the medium of a disk record of Victrolac<sup>1</sup> recorded through a high-fidelily recording system and reproduced through a properly compensated high-fidelity reproducing system. Following the reproduction of the record, the meeting was opened to a general discussion of the system.
